## Safety

- [ ] This change was submitted from a feature branch; no commit was pushed directly to `main`.
- [ ] `Full CI` is green for the latest unchanged commit. Missing, skipped, cancelled, or stale evidence is not accepted.
- [ ] On GitHub Free Private, I manually verified the SHA because server-side Rulesets are unavailable.
- [ ] No generated JSON was hand-edited.
- [ ] No secret, `.env`, credential, or production data is included.

- [ ] Architecture and local-first boundaries are preserved or documented by an ADR.
